module: "Export" section of the Dynamic Decals tool. Two blocks: "Export Skin" (player vehicle name + skin name, calls api.exportSkin to generate textures, material and JBeam) and "Export Textures" (name, folder, default /art/dynamicDecals/export/textures, then api.exportTextures as PNG). Displays the output paths and warns if a file already exists.
notes: The files exported for textures are <folder>/<name>_color, _metallic, _roughness, _colorPalette as .png; _normal is disabled.
The DDS format is disabled: exportTextures forces "png" regardless of the format passed.
Spaces in the skin / export name are replaced by "_".
The vehicle name is read from getPlayerVehicle(0).jbeam and the field is read-only; if no vehicle exists, the last value (empty initially) is kept.
The default value skinExport_Vehicle ("vivace") is not used.

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the API and docs, prepares the format list (dds, png) for ImGui, computes the export paths, registers the "Export" section (order 25) and its documentation page.
